issue_context.title: Entering a URI that's not a path should use the system launcher
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Not really. In File Explorer, when you enter any URI that's not a path, it will launch it using the system launcher. That doesn't work in FIles UWP.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
When FIles UWP can't navigate to the given string, it should try to use the system launcher to launch it.
comments: @Jaiganeshkumaran What exact string you are trying to launch?
I was actually trying open a website since in Explorer it works.
